messages:
sam: kicked off a benchmark thread — testing multiple FlashAttention variants, paged-attention, and fused attention on A100 / H100 / L40S. sweep: seq=[64,512,2048], bsz=[1,8,16], KV-prefetch on/off. baseline = flash-raw.

maria: nice. did you enable async prefetch and the hybrid-tiling kernel? any memspill or unexpected evictions?

sam: async prefetch = on only for H100 runs, hybrid-tiling enabled on A100. memspill only observed on L40S at seq=2048 bsz=16 — KV evict counts spike there. quick perf summary pasted below.

sam: ```
A100:
  seq64 b1   -> 1.2 ms/token
  seq512 b8  -> 0.9 ms/token
  seq2048 b16-> 3.6 ms/token
H100:
  seq64 b1   -> 0.9 ms/token
  seq512 b8  -> 0.7 ms/token
  seq2048 b16-> 2.8 ms/token
L40S:
  seq64 b1   -> 1.5 ms/token
  seq512 b8  -> 1.4 ms/token
  seq2048 b16-> 5.2 ms/token

KV-prefetch:on -> ~-18% avg ms/token on H100 for seq>=512
KV-prefetch:on -> increased memspill on L40S at high bsz (evict_count +3.8x)
```

cheng: can you paste the kernel-selection heatmap? curious which kernels lost to fallback on L40S.

sam: heatmap: https://internal/bench/3098765432/heatmap.png — TL;DR: fused-paged-flash selected for most seq<=512 combos, but for seq2048 on L40S we fell back to paged-only due to fragmentation + lack of contiguous workspace.

alex: any quality/regression diffs vs baseline? and what's the batching heuristic you used for these runs?

sam: no output diffs detected vs baseline generation tests (small eval set). batching heuristic = dynamic_batcher with short latency cap and seq-aware thresholds. config snippet: ```json
{"batch_timeout_ms":10, "seq_thresholds": {"<128":32, "128-1024":8, ">1024":2}}
```

lee: saw logs flagged with `kv_cache_eviction:heavy` during the L40S seq2048 b16 run. can we add a soft cap on max_cached_tokens per model/profile to avoid thrash?

maria: +1 to soft cap. also consider degrading to the quantized flash variant on L40S for seq>1024 as an experiment — reduces memory footprint at small cost to fp quality.

perf-bot: benchmark finished. artifacts uploaded: s3://bench/3098765432/{metrics.json,heatmap.png,logs.tar.gz} :white_check_mark:

sam: next steps — 1) enable prefetch only for H100/A100 and disable on L40S, 2) implement soft kv cache cap and run again, 3) finer bsz sweep at seq2048 to pinpoint threshold. assigning to cheng + alex. @cheng @alex

cheng: taking it. will reproduce with kv-cap patch and post results in this thread.

alex: will try the quantized flash fallback on L40S and report perf/memory tradeoffs.

sam: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the follow-ups.
